A quick weeknight dinner: Garlic Shrimp Pasta. Cook 8 oz linguine per package. Meanwhile, sauté 1 lb peeled shrimp in 2 Tbsp olive oil with 3 minced garlic cloves, red‑pepper flakes, salt, and pepper for 2‑3 min per side. Add a splash of white wine or lemon juice, toss with cooked pasta, finish with chopped parsley and grated Parmesan. Serve immediately.
